page: Microsoft Azure E4d_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8272CL processor running at a base clock speed of 2.6 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed by Microsoft Hyper-V, the configuration provides 4 virtual CPUs derived from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. Cache allocation includes 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache. Vector processing instruction support covers AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI, alongside hardware-accelerated AES cryptography.

The instance delivers an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio, featuring 32.0 GB of system memory (8.0 GB per virtual CPU), alongside a bundled 161 GB local SSD for temporary scratch space, cache arrays, or swap partitions. No graphics processing hardware is present, and public IPv4 addresses are not included complimentary. In synthetic CPU testing, the instance exhibits entry-tier compute capabilities, registering a Geekbench single-core score of 1234.0 and a multi-core score of 2747.0, with a PassMark CPU score of 4379.53. Memory throughput measures 22.87 GB/sec for uncached read operations and 17.84 GB/sec for large block writes.

From an operational and resource perspective, the E4d_v4 prioritizes memory density over multi-threaded computational speed. Database operations in PassMark reached 1382.57, while Redis key-value SET throughput achieved 3.55 million operations per second. Static web serving throughput peaked at 4.03 GB/sec. These characteristics make the instance effective for caching layers, mid-sized relational databases, in-memory processing pipelines, and data analysis tasks that require generous memory capacity and local temporary storage without requiring high-density raw compute cycles.
description: Microsoft Azure E4d_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine tailored for memory-bound cloud workloads. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical Intel Xeon 8272CL cores operating at 2.6 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, supported by 32.0 GB of system memory and 161 GB of integrated local SSD storage. Instruction set extensions include AVX-512 and AES. Benchmark evaluations position the instance with moderate single-core responsiveness and limited parallel compute bandwidth, reflected by a Geekbench multi-core score of 2747.0 and Redis SET throughput of 3.55 million operations per second. Memory bandwidth yields 22.87 GB/sec on uncached block reads. Given its generous memory-to-core allocation and bundled high-speed temporary storage, the instance functions effectively for caching tiers, relational databases, search indexes, and general enterprise data workloads that do not demand heavy parallel processing power.
